title: Bitwise NOT operator
starterCode:
const num = 42
return {
  bitwiseNot: ~num,
  doubleNot: ~~num,
  floorExample: ~~3.9,
  indexOf: ~"hello".indexOf("x"),
  indexOfFound: ~"hello".indexOf("e")
}
solution:
const num = 42
return {
  bitwiseNot: ~num,
  doubleNot: ~~num,
  floorExample: ~~3.9,
  indexOf: ~"hello".indexOf("x"),
  indexOfFound: ~"hello".indexOf("e")
}

~(-1) = 0 — truthy/falsy check ke liye use hota hai
